is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) populations in Benin (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for L1014F-VGSC and G119S-ace-1 (page 1, Abstract).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (pages 7-9) provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for L1014F-VGSC and G119S-ace-1 for multiple populations and years.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses field-collected Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) larvae from 13 localities in Benin (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data collected between 2013 and 2015 (page 2, Methods).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 13 specific localities in Benin (Table 1, page 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data from a 3-year survey (2013-2015) (page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new data collected between 2013 and 2015. While it compares these to previously published data (2006-2010), the 2013-2015 data are presented as new empirical findings.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts are provided in Table 2 (pages 7-9).

assessment.summary: This study reports on the insecticide resistance status and resistance marker frequencies (L1014F-VGSC and G119S-ace-1) of Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) populations in 13 localities across Benin, collected between 2013 and 2015. It compares these findings with historical data (2006-2010) to assess evolutionary trends.
